name: Khorezm People's Soviet Republic
native: Хорезмская Народная Советская Республика (Khorezmskaya Narodnaya Sovetskaya Respublika)

predecessors.name: Khanate of Khiva
predecessors.text: the khanate, whose Khan abdicated in February 1920

successors.name: Soviet Union
successors.text: the Karakalpak lands, to the Karakalpak AO

ledger.x: 1920: the Khan of Khiva abdicates and the Khorezm republic is born.
1923: the republic becomes the Khorezm Socialist Soviet Republic.

wars.name: Junaid Khan's raids on Khorezm
wars.outcome: Junaid Khan 'briefly captured Khorezm in April 1922'; no lasting border change.

certainty.note: The republic's borders with the Turkestan ASSR and the Bukharan PSR are described on KH but not surveyed; the desert margins are approximate.

sources.title: National delimitation in the Soviet Union
